    • 字段详细资料

      • DBInstanceName

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceName")
public String DBInstanceName

        The instance ID of the destination instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        pgm-bp102g323jd4****

      • resourceOwnerId

        @NameInMap(value="ResourceOwnerId")
public Long resourceOwnerId

      • sourceAccount

        @NameInMap(value="SourceAccount")
public String sourceAccount

        The username. The database account created in the Create a migration account step.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        migratetest

      • sourceCategory

        @NameInMap(value="SourceCategory")
public String sourceCategory

        The category of the source instance. Valid values:

        • aliyunRDS: Alibaba Cloud RDS instance.
        • other: Other.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        aliyunRDS

      • sourceIpAddress

        @NameInMap(value="SourceIpAddress")
public String sourceIpAddress

        The internal or public IP address of the self-managed PostgreSQL database.

        • For the one-click cloud migration scenario of a self-managed PostgreSQL database on an ECS instance, set this parameter to the private IP address of the ECS instance. For more information, see View IP addresses.
        • For the one-click cloud migration scenario of a self-managed PostgreSQL database in an IDC, set this parameter to the internal IP address of the IDC.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        172.16.XX.XX

      • sourcePassword

        @NameInMap(value="SourcePassword")
public String sourcePassword

        The password. The password of the database account created in the Create a migration account step.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        123456

      • sourcePort

        @NameInMap(value="SourcePort")
public Long sourcePort

        The port of the self-managed PostgreSQL database. You can run the netstat -a | grep PGSQL command to view the port.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        5432

      • taskName

        @NameInMap(value="TaskName")
public String taskName

        The name of the task. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify a name, the system automatically generates one.

        example:

        362c6c7a-4d20-4eac-898c-1495ceab374c
